title: Naturality of the characterized first-factor localization map
statement: Let R,A,B,Aq,D be commutative rings with compatible R-algebra structures and maps A -> Aq, A tensor_R B -> D and Aq tensor_R B -> D as in [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let Q be an A-module cochain complex, L a base-derived tensor cohomology model of Q tensor-derived_R B, and K such a model of (Aq tensor_A Q) tensor-derived_R B. Let i be an integer. Define u_Q on the underlying R-complex by x |-> 1 tensor x. Let zeta:L.derived -> K.derived be the unique counit-compatible derived-functor isomorphism. Define c_(L,K) as (L.cohomologyIso i).hom followed by H^i(L.derived(u_Q)), H^i(zeta at Aq tensor_A Q), and (K.cohomologyIso i).inv. A D-linear morphism e is characterized when e(1 tensor x)=1 tensor c_(L,K)(x) for every x. For a chain map f:Q -> Qprime, let Lprime,Kprime be the corresponding models, and let e and eprime be characterized D-linear isomorphisms. Suppose delta:L.derived -> Lprime.derived and epsilon:K.derived -> Kprime.derived are counit-compatible. Let g and h be tensor-algebra-linear maps whose restrictions to B are the degree-i cohomology maps induced by f and delta, and Aq tensor_A f and epsilon respectively, using the model cohomology identifications. Then (D tensor g);eprime=e;(D tensor h). No localization or scalar-compatibility hypotheses on D are needed beyond the characterization.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, affine localization identity; Tag 06Y6, lemma-derived-base-change

proof.text: Check naturality of u_Q on each term: both composites send x to 1 tensor f(x). The uniqueness of transformations into a left derived functor, applied to their counits, gives delta;zeta_prime=zeta;epsilon.

Apply naturality of delta and zeta and the functor map_comp law to the commuting unit square. Apply degree-i cohomology and substitute the characterizations of g,h. Cancel the cohomology isomorphisms to obtain g;c_(Lprime,Kprime)=c_(L,K);h over B.
Evaluate the desired D-linear equality on 1 tensor x. The formulas for e,eprime and extendScalars.map_tmul reduce it to the preceding equality. ExtendScalars.hom_ext concludes.

theorem firstLocalization_naturality (i : ℤ)
    (Q Q' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : Q ⟶ Q')
          (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
          (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q) D)
          (L' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q' D)
          (K' : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q') D)
          (δ : L.derived ⟶ L'.derived) (ε : K.derived ⟶ K'.derived)
          (g : L.cohomology i ⟶ L'.cohomology i)
          (h : K.cohomology i ⟶ K'.cohomology i)
    (e : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (L.cohomology i) ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (K.cohomology i))
    (e' : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (L'.cohomology i) ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (K'.cohomology i))
    (he : IsFirstLocalizationMap R A Aq B D Q L K i e.hom)
    (he' : IsFirstLocalizationMap R A Aq B D Q' L' K' i e'.hom) :
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) δ ≫
            L'.counit = L.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map g ≫
              (L'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (L.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (L.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R A).map f)))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (δ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R A).obj Q')))) →
        Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) ε ≫
            K'.counit = K.counit →
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] Aq ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map h ≫
              (K'.cohomologyIso i).hom =
          (K.cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (K.derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
                  ((restrict R Aq).map ((extend A Aq).map f))))) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
              (ε.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
                  ((restrict R Aq).obj ((extend A Aq).obj Q'))))) →
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).map g ≫
            e'.hom =
          e.hom ≫
            (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (Aq ⊗[R] B) D)).map h
